recommendation: Keep the commit as-is; it completes the already-applied FHIR-50487 alignment in core without changing unrelated DEQM-specific wording or reopening the broader submit-data deprecation direction.
issue_request: FHIR-50487 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 by CQI and asked that the core Measure $submit-data operation be aligned with the DEQM STU 5 $submit-data operation, including Bundle-based submission, no instance-level invocation, quality-reporting guidance, and an updated Bundle request example.
initial_application: HL7/fhir commits 894f1a69b8 and 7146e4e1cf, linked from Jira comments as PR #3778 and PR #3932, applied most of the request: operation prose, type-level-only invocation, quality-reporting guidance, and a Bundle-shaped request body. They left a semantic mismatch because the input parameter was still typed as MeasureReport, the example text still invoked an instance URL, and the embedded MeasureReport still used patient instead of subject.
additional_context: The DEQM STU 5 OperationDefinition has a single 1..* input parameter named bundle with type Bundle and type=true, instance=false. FHIR-46373 is the DEQM same-change-family issue that created the multi-measure submit-data operation with Bundle input, and FHIR-51066 is the adjacent core collect-data alignment issue that uses Bundle for the multi-cardinality operation payload pattern. Measure is active and approved in fhir.ini, and the Measure operation list references OperationDefinition/Measure-submit-data.
reconciliation: Changed source/measure/operationdefinition-Measure-submit-data.xml so the bundle input parameter is type Bundle, changed source/measure/$submit-data-request.txt to POST [base]/Measure/$submit-data, and changed source/measure/submit-data-request.json so the example MeasureReport uses subject.
source_changes: source/measure/operationdefinition-Measure-submit-data.xml: changed the Measure $submit-data bundle input parameter type from MeasureReport to Bundle.
source/measure/$submit-data-request.txt: changed the request example from the disallowed instance URL to [base]/Measure/$submit-data.
source/measure/submit-data-request.json: changed the embedded MeasureReport example from patient to subject.

related_jiras.note: DEQM Published issue that created the multi-measure submit-data operation with a 1..* Bundle input parameter and type-level invocation.
Core collect-data alignment issue already represented on the combined branch; its source uses Bundle for the adjacent multi-cardinality operation payload pattern.
Jira comment on FHIR-50487 says this earlier discussion led to filing operation-alignment tickets, but it was not needed as an independent decision here.
